notes: SOS "Proposed Ballot Measure Information" page. Lists, per 2026 initiative, the ballot title letter, full text, explanatory statement, fiscal impact statement, public investment impact disclosure (IP26-645 only) and arguments/rebuttals PDFs, plus the 2026 Certification of Measures to General Election. OFM's fiscal impact page (https://ofm.wa.gov/spending/fiscal-impact/statements-general-election/, reached from www.ofm.wa.gov/ballot as printed in the pamphlet) hosts no PDFs of its own and points to this page.
